title: [29.x]-TDS Amount incorrectly calculated under Tax Information Factbox if you use Applies-to ID in the Indian version.
summary: Fixed TDS amount calculation in the Indian version when applying payments via Applies-to ID, which was incorrectly deducting the gross payment amount instead of the TDS base amount.
key_points: The TDS use case (Applies-to ID) was overwriting the correctly summed TDS base amount with the gross payment amount
Removed the erroneous expression to preserve AppliedAmount as the sum of posted TDS Base Amounts
Updated use case version from 5 to 6 and registered version in TDSTaxConfiguration to ensure the corrected logic is re-imported
TDS now calculates correctly for single and multiple applied payments
quote: TDS was over-deducted on a Purchase Invoice when a payment was applied via Applies-to ID
